import { expect } from "bun:test";

export function skipped(entry: { name: string }, segments: string[]): boolean {
  return (
    entry.name === "node_modules" ||
    segments.includes("node_modules") ||
    entry.name.startsWith("node_modules") ||
    entry.name.endsWith("node_modules") ||
    segments.indexOf("node_modules") >= 0
  );
}

export function asserted(found: string[]): void {
  expect(found).toEqual(["node_modules"]);
}
